newsitem.title: CHINA: Sixty pct of Shanghai urban families have phones.
newsitem.headline: Sixty pct of Shanghai urban families have phones.

text.p: Shanghai now has three million personal telephone subscribers and 60 percent of urban families have telephones installed at home, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
The city also has 330,000 mobile phone subscribers and 900,000 pager owners, the agency said.
The city expects 700,000 more private telephone lines to be installed by the end of this year and the cellular phone population to more than double to 780,000, Xinhua said.
